simple.meaning: צְבִי (tsᵉbîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “splendor (as conspicuous ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 32 times across Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Proverbs, and 5 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 12:15. Its contexts include family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְבִי (H6643).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צְבִי (tsᵉbîy) / H6643 is traced through Deuteronomy 12:15, Deuteronomy 12:22, Deuteronomy 14:5, Deuteronomy 15:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6643. tsbiy I. צְבִי noun masculine 2Sam 1:19 beauty, honour ; — absolute ׳צ 1:19 +, צֶבִ֑י Dan 8:9 ; construct צְבִי Isa 13:19 +; plural construct צִבְאוֺת Jer 3:19 (so ᵑ7 Ki Thes Hi Gf Ol § 145 b Kö ii.l, 584 and others; > from ᵑ6 צבא Gie and others); — 1. a. beauty, decoration , ׳צ עֶדְיוֺ , of silver and gold Ezek 7:20 , of products of soil Isa 4:2 (predict.) b. elsewhere in figure: of drunkard's chaplet , ׳צ תִפְאַרְתּוֺ Isa 28:1 , 4 (figurative of Samaria); צ ׳עֲטֶרֶת 28:5 (of ׳י ); ׳הַצּ 2Sam 1:19 (Saul and Jonathan); כָּלצֿ ׳גְּאוֺן , of Tyre Isa 23:9 ; ׳צ מַמְלָכוֺת 13:19 (of Babylonian ); of land of Israel (Judah), לְכָלהָֿאֲרָצוֺת הִיא צְבִי Ezek 20:6 , 15 , צִבְאוֺת צְבִי נַחֲלַת גּוֺיִם Jer 3:19 (see above) heritage of the beauty of beauties of the nations , i.e. most beauteous heritage; ׳הַצּ especially of Jerusalem and temple Dan 8:9 (Bev), compare הַצּ ׳אֶרֶץ 11:16 , 41 (see Dr), צ קֹֿרֶשׁ׳הַר 11:45 (i.e. temple-hill); of cities of Moab, ׳צ אֶרֶץ Ezek 25:9 . 2 = honour , ׳צ דִּיק׳לַצּ Isa 24:16 . — Ezek 26:20 read בִי׳וְתִתְיַצְּ for צְבִי וְנָתַתִּי , so Lxx Co Berthol Toy Krae and others III. צבה (√ of following; Late Hebrew צְבִיָה צְבִי, = Biblical Hebrew; so Assyrian ƒabîtu , Arabic Aramaic טַבְיָה ). II. צְבִי noun masculine Isa 13:14 gazelle ; — ׳צ absolute Deut 12:15 +; plural צְבָיִם 2Sam 2:18 , צְבָאיִם 1Chr 12:9 (Gi Baer; van d. H. v. 12:8 ), צְבָאוֺת Song 2:7 ; 3:5 ; — gazelle , allowed as food Deut 14:5 , compare 12:15 , 22 (although not for sacrifice, Dr; all + אַיָּל ), so 15:22 (+ יַחְמוּר אַיָּל, , etc.), see 1Kin 5:3 ; simile of swiftness 2Sam 2:18 ; 1Chr 12:9 see above, Prov 6:5 ; of grace and beauty Song 2:9 , 17 ; 8:14 (compare Jacob Arab. Dichter iv. 20 f. ); hence used in adjuration 2:7 ; 3:5 ( + אילות ); ׳צ מֻדָּח Isa 13:14 , simile of fugitives.
